split_modules._what_this_is: Runner-only, opt-in test-granularity splits. Every declared test plus the computed remainder still runs once per suite/interpreter. Only previously audited independent splits remain enabled. tests.test_calibration_exits stays absent: its WitnessCorpusOwner executes the complete ordered witness sweep for every process-local cache, so distributing consumers duplicates work and separates generation-bound inventory checks. The old _WITNESS_RESULTS/alphabetical-priming explanation is superseded by that explicit owner.
split_modules._why_declared_plus_remainder: Only the heavy test ids are named. Everything else is gathered at run time into one remainder unit. A test ADDED to a split module therefore lands in the remainder automatically - it cannot be silently dropped from the suite. A DECLARED id that disappears (a rename) fails the build closed, which is the case a computed complement would otherwise absorb silently while handing one shard ~20 minutes of unaccounted work.
